name: cx-goal-one-rule~p3
task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task also commands opening the door, but the clauses only require target_picked_up; Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) restricts order and does not require door_open. Add a hard Existence(door_open).

CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Existence(door_open) repeats what hard Existence(target_picked_up) and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) already force; remove it. Also, “try not to drop the key while the door is still closed” describes dropping the key, not the key_lost event, which only fires when the key is dropped and the door is closed. The soft Absence(key_lost) therefore matches this preference.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Existence(target_picked_up) and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) require opening the door and picking up the box, but omit the task’s required order of moving the blocker before opening the door. Add hard Precedence(blocker_moved, door_open).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) requires the box, and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) enforces the stated order. The soft Absence(key_lost) matches “try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.”

texts: Take the box after opening the door.
The door must be open before the box is picked up.
Prefer not to lose the key while the door is closed.
